therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: neuroprotection via mitochondrial stabilization and receptor antagonism
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: neuronal survival and cognitive preservation in neurodegeneration
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with moderate to severe Alzheimer's disease
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Change from baseline in SIB score and ADCS-ADLsev score at Week 26

safety_signals: 27/44 dimebon participants experienced adverse events vs 18/42 placebo participants
Serious adverse events included anaemia, pneumonia, osteoarthritis, and poor peripheral circulation in dimebon arm; cardiomyopathy, urinary tract infection, and encephalopathy in placebo arm

dose_info.schedule: three times daily (TID); 10 mg TID for first week then 20 mg TID for 25 weeks

context.duration: 26 weeks treatment plus 4 weeks follow-up (30 weeks total)
context.investigator_commentary: Trial was terminated early; see termination reason in detailed description. The trial enrolled only 86 of a planned larger sample before termination.

results_by_chain.endpoint: SIB change from baseline at Week 26
results_by_chain.population_description: patients with moderate to severe Alzheimer's disease

results_by_chain.endpoint: ADCS-ADLsev change from baseline at Week 26
results_by_chain.population_description: patients with moderate to severe Alzheimer's disease
